newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oils close virtually unchanged from midday.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oils close virtually unchanged from midday.

text.p: European vegetable oils closed firmer but basically unmoved from the midday levels, traders said.
Earlier gains were attributed to overnight gains on both the Malaysian palm oil and Chicago soybean oil futures.
However, opening trading in Chicago on Wednesday saw little movement from Tuesday's close, which if held up to the close would point towards little change in Europe on Thursday.
Coconut oil ended the day unchanged to $5 firmer, with trade ranging from Feb/Mar at $735 through to Jun/Jul at $715.
The palm oil sector also finished unchanged to $5 above Tuesday's close. During the afternoon Jun traded at $550 for Jun and Jul/Sep at $547.50.
The softs oils managed just the one trade throughout the day, which was for soy oil at 100 guilders on May/Jul. Values ended 0.50 to one guilder up.
